name: Distributes to the first term only
description: Multiplies the factor outside the brackets by the first term but not the others, e.g. 3(x + 2) → 3x + 2.

name: Sign error distributing a negative
description: Forgets that a negative factor flips the sign of every term, e.g. -2(x - 3) → -2x - 6.

name: Adds numerators and denominators
description: Adds fractions by adding tops and bottoms, e.g. 1/2 + 1/3 → 2/5.

name: Moves a term without changing its sign
description: Moves a term across the equals sign without applying the inverse operation, e.g. x + 5 = 12 → x = 17.

name: Combines unlike terms
description: Adds terms with different variable parts, e.g. 4x + 3 + 2x → 9x.

name: Multiplies exponents when multiplying powers
description: Uses x^a · x^b = x^(ab) instead of x^(a+b).

name: Squares each term of a sum
description: Writes (a + b)² as a² + b², missing the 2ab cross term.

name: Splits a square root over addition
Uses the new value as the base
description: Divides the change by the final value instead of the original, e.g. ₹500 → ₹600 gives 100/600 ≈ 16.7%.

name: Uses a + nd for the nth term
description: Forgets the (n − 1) in aₙ = a + (n − 1)d, so every term is one step too far.
